text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower offers me a New Year's
greeting as
we begin our first meeting of
the year.
choice_data_list: おめでとうございます

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This marks the start of my classic year.
I'm sure
there's plenty of races you want
me to take on,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll work my hardest to bring a smile to
your face!
Let's make this year a great
one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's smile is dazzling. As I
think about
how this year is shaping up
to be as peaceful as
the last one, I ask
her a question.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I have!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My goal this year is to grow big and tall!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You see, I had my height measured
during my
health checkup the other
day...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I thought that with my training in full
swing and
the fact that I'm eating more
than I used to, I'd
have grown a little
taller.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... I haven't changed at all. I'm not
even a
single millimeter taller...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to grow bigger as fast
as
possible!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I know you're right, but still...
choice_data_list: 焦らなくて大丈夫だよ

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The older students here are all so
elegant. Seeing
them every day just
makes me wish I was the
same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get where she's coming from, but this is
one
problem that can't be solved
through sheer will.
How should I
encourage her to think positively?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Jumping?
choice_data_list: いっぱいジャンプしに行く？
おっきい子の話を聞こう！
大きくなる勉強をしようか

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Everyone's bouncing on
trampolines!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They look like they're having so much
fun...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But everyone here is smaller than me...
Wouldn't I
just get in their way?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Flower! Are you here for the
trampolines,
too?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Mayano Top Gun. She's one of
Nishino
Flower's classmates, and they
apparently often
eat lunch together.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I love it here! If you time your jumps with

everyone, you can fly waaay up high! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And the more of us there are, the funner
it is!
C'mon, Flower! You're cleared for
takeoff!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoooa! I'm so high up, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ☆ You're flying up above your
trainer's
head, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right! Hehe! ♪ I guess I grew
up pretty
quickly!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...A tall student?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bubble, bubble...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you want to grow big quickly. Is
that the
gist of it, Flower? ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We talk with Hishi Akebono. Her heart is
just as
big as her towering frame is tall,
and she and
Nishino Flower get along
great.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I do, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What's in that pot?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Chanko! I used to eat this all the time
when I was
growing up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it works the same way for

everyone, but this stew is surely the
reason I'm so
tall.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So dig in, Flower! Eat up, and you'll
grow big and
strong!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You mean... you made this for me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! I'd love some!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phwooo. It's nice and warm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I really do feel like eating this will make
me grow
bigger somehow!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's great! ☆ I've still got plenty of
room to
grow, too, so let's get bigger
together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sure!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Have some more! I made three more
pots' worth,
so eat up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank y—wait, you what?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Great idea! Yeah, we should study up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I think I know just the right person
who can
help!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
These are the books in my possession
that include
specialized methods of
increasing one's height.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All are based on verified factual
information. I'm
certain you'll find
something that can be of use to
you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... It's just...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that maybe I could... take
part in
one of your experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is quite an enticing offer.
However...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems your trainer is opposed to the
notion.
And besides, such an experiment
offers no merit
for me. Not at this time,
anyway.
choice_data_list: ちょっと持ち帰らせて……！

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Go read those books and learn all you
can. I'm
sure you'll be able to grasp
something that will
serve you in the
future. Farewell, then.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon is so cool. If I study really hard,
then...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! So I'll do my best!
